name: nokhba-pms

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build

//: Build-time packages (tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, typescript, @types/*) live in dependencies on purpose. Hosts that install with NODE_ENV=production or `npm ci --omit=dev` skip devDependencies entirely — without typescript Next cannot read tsconfig.json, so the `@/*` path aliases stop resolving, and without tailwindcss the CSS pipeline fails. Only the lint toolchain, which the build does not need, stays in devDependencies.
